jp: 授業中[じゅぎょうちゅう]、誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}質問[しつもん]{を|o-object}しませんでした。
en: Nobody asked a question during the class.
why: 誰 + も with a negative verb means nobody at all did it.

jp: 昨日[きのう]{は|wa-topic}頭[あたま]{が|ga-subject}痛[いた]くて、何[なに]{も|mo-total-negation}勉強[べんきょう]できませんでした。
en: Yesterday I had a headache and couldn't study anything.
why: 何 + も with a negative verb means not anything at all.

jp: 会議[かいぎ]{で|de-place}何[なに]{も|mo-total-negation}決[き]まりませんでした。
en: Nothing was decided at the meeting.
why: 何も with a negative verb means not a single thing was decided.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{の|no-possessive}質問[しつもん]{に|ni-target}誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}答[こた]えられませんでした。
en: Nobody could answer the teacher's question.
why: 誰も with a negative verb means no one could do it.

jp: 試験[しけん]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{は|wa-topic}、何[なに]{も|mo-total-negation}食[た]べたくありませんでした。
en: Before the exam I didn't want to eat anything.
why: 何も with a negative form means not anything; the negative ending is required.

jp: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}仕事[しごと]{で|de-cause}どこ{に/へ|ni-destination}{も|mo-total-negation}行[い]けませんでした。
en: My older brother couldn't go anywhere because of work.
why: どこ + に/へ + も with a negative verb means not anywhere at all.

jp: 私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}まだ誰[だれ]{に|ni-target}{も|mo-total-negation}この話[はなし]{を|o-object}していません。
en: I haven't told anyone about this yet.
why: 誰にも with a negative verb means to nobody at all.

jp: 仕事[しごと]{の|no-possessive}後[あと]{は|wa-topic}眠[ねむ]くて、何[なに]{も|mo-total-negation}したくありません。
en: After work I'm so sleepy that I don't want to do anything.
why: 何も with a negative form means not anything at all.
